periods.time: vol-10 ch-004, immediately after Ikki's semifinal win

name.zh: 天音败北后死神之手失控

periods.summary: After the referee declares Ikki's victory, Amane cannot accept that Nameless Glory is not absolute and stands again in tears. He concentrates his causality into visible black hands that impose the result of death directly, attacking the referee and then the spectator areas. Kurono orders the knights to protect the audience, and Nene warns everyone to avoid direct contact. Ikki refuses to leave the matter to the adults because Amane's hatred is directed at him, activates Ittou Shura, and cuts through the death hands. When Amane finally abandons luck and attacks with a sword motion learned from his own repeated lucky movements, Ikki stops the final thrust with his second secret sword Rekkou / Rekkou-like close-range counter and defeats him. Ikki then tells Amane to remember his regret and challenge him whenever he wants, giving him a reason not to abandon himself.
periods.cause: Amane's self-abandonment depended on believing his ability was invincible; Ikki's victory threatens that justification.
periods.outcome: No spectators are harmed, Amane is subdued and emotionally redirected, but a death result has grazed Ikki and later causes his collapse.
casualties: arena surfaces and spectator fixtures partially decayed
ikki-kurogane secretly infected by a death result graze
periods.significance: Shows the most lethal expression of Amane's ability while completing Ikki's role as someone who defeats despair by becoming a target worth chasing.
